title: ONI Companion Link: companion/sync/status.json (v1.2)
description: Written by the mod (write-tmp-then-rename) while a sync_assets command runs, about every 250 ms, and once more when it ends. The core turns it into GET /api/v1/sync and a `sync` event. Nothing in it is game art; it only counts. The mod pauses the game while state is running and restores the previous speed (and paused flag) when it ends, also when it fails.

total.description: Items to draw in this run (0 until counted).

current.description: What is being drawn right now, display text: "<kind>: <id>".

stages.description: Parts of the run in order; the first one not done is where it is.

gamePausedBySync.description: True while the mod holds the game paused; false once the previous speed is restored.

worstFrameMs.description: Informational: the run is not frame-budgeted.
